metadata.hypothesis_title: Thalamocortical Network Dynamics and Insomnia Severity

critic_findings.message: The use of Spearman correlation may not capture the complexity of thalamocortical FC relationships as effectively as linear regression.
critic_findings.recommendation: Consider implementing linear regression as recommended in the model review for more accurate modeling.

critic_findings.message: Bootstrap confidence intervals showed some variability, indicating potential sensitivity to sample characteristics.
critic_findings.recommendation: Increase sample size or use alternative robustness checks for more stable results.
